description: Get daily click/impression/CTR/position trend for a specific page. Use this to see how a single page's search performance has changed over time, useful for measuring the impact of a content update or spotting a ranking drop. Requires Google Search Console to be connected. Direct the user to rankparse.com/dashboard/integrations to connect it. When several Google accounts are connected, the property is read through the account that can see it.
name: get_gsc_page_trend
